documents.text:
Alex Rivera — Data Engineer
Skills: Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Git, Linux
Experience:
- 5 years as Data Engineer at current company
- Built ETL pipelines using Python and SQL
- Used Apache Spark in 2022 for a batch processing project
- Strong SQL skills used daily for reporting and analysis
Education: B.S. Computer Science

Performance Review — Alex Rivera (2023)
Python: Alex demonstrates excellent Python skills. 
His pipeline work is clean and well-documented.
SQL: Solid SQL skills, uses it regularly for reporting.
Leadership: Alex is still developing his leadership skills. 
He tends to work independently and needs to improve 
collaboration and mentoring of junior team members.
Overall: Good contributor, needs growth in soft skills.

Peer Review — Alex Rivera (2023)
Alex is a strong team player and always willing to help.
He is a fast learner who picks up new technologies quickly.
Communication could be improved in cross-team meetings.

Maria Chen — Data Analyst
Skills: Python, Apache Spark, dbt, Tableau, SQL
Experience:
- 6 years in data roles
- Heavy Spark usage for large-scale analytics (last used 2024)
- dbt for data transformation pipelines (last used 2024)
- SQL used 3 years ago primarily, moved to Spark since then
Education: M.S. Data Science

Performance Review — Maria Chen (2024)
Maria is an exceptional technical contributor.
Her Spark and dbt skills are top-notch.
Python: Strong, used in all her projects.
Leadership: Maria tends to work solo and has not taken 
on mentoring responsibilities yet.

James Patel — Software Engineer
Skills: Python, TensorFlow, Statistics, SQL, Java
Experience:
- 4 years software engineering
- TensorFlow model training (last used 2024)
- ML model deployment experience in 2024
- Statistics and probability applied in A/B testing
Education: B.S. Computer Science, Minor in Statistics

Performance Review — James Patel (2024)
James has strong Python and TensorFlow skills.
His statistical analysis work is solid.
Communication: James communicates clearly with 
both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
ML Deployment: Has deployed 2 models to production this year.

Peer Review — James Patel (2024)
James is collaborative and easy to work with.
He explains complex ML concepts clearly to the team.

Sarah Kim — ML Research Engineer
Skills: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Docker, Kubernetes
Experience:
- 7 years in ML and AI roles
- TensorFlow and PyTorch used extensively (last used 2026)
- Docker for containerized model deployment (last used 2026)
- Statistics: used 3 years ago in research context
Education: Ph.D. Machine Learning

Performance Review — Sarah Kim (2026)
Sarah is one of our strongest ML engineers.
TensorFlow and PyTorch: Expert-level proficiency.
Docker: Excellent containerization skills.
Communication: Sarah struggles to communicate 
her research clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
This is an area for development.

Peer Review — Sarah Kim (2026)
Sarah's technical skills are outstanding.
She is detail-oriented and produces high quality work.

David Osei — Healthcare IT Specialist
Skills: HIPAA Compliance, HL7, EHR Systems (Epic), 
Leadership, Project Management
Experience:
- 8 years in healthcare IT
- HIPAA compliance management (last used 2026)
- HL7 integration projects (last used 2026)
- Epic EHR system administration (last used 2026)
- Led team of 4 for 3 years
- Project management certification (PMP, 2024)
Education: B.S. Health Informatics

Performance Review — David Osei (2026)
David is an outstanding healthcare IT professional.
HIPAA: Deep compliance expertise, our go-to person.
HL7: Strong integration skills demonstrated this year.
Leadership: David leads his team with confidence and clarity.
Project Management: His PMP certification shows, 
projects are consistently on time and on budget.

Peer Review — David Osei (2026)
David is an excellent mentor and team leader.
His knowledge of healthcare systems is unmatched.

Priya Nair — IT Project Manager
Skills: Project Management, HIPAA, Leadership, 
Communication, HL7, Agile
Experience:
- 5 years IT project management
- HIPAA compliance awareness (last used 2025)
- HL7: worked with HL7 standards 3 years ago
- Strong leadership of cross-functional teams
- Excellent communication skills
Education: MBA, B.S. Information Systems

Performance Review — Priya Nair (2025)
Priya is an excellent project manager.
Leadership: Strong, leads teams with clarity.
Communication: Outstanding, one of her greatest strengths.
HIPAA: Good awareness but not deep technical expertise.
HL7: Limited hands-on experience, more theoretical knowledge.
